prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):

   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_pet_controls"], "new_pet_controls": {"headline": "Desktop Companion Quick Controls", "body": "Discover how to summon, minimize, and chat with your desktop pet effortlessly.", "layout": "centered"}}
1: [sign_in, redesign] Sign in layout account recovery focus redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen using a list layout focused on account restoration and pet inventory synchronization.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "list", "headline": "Sign In to Sync & Protect Your Pets", "body": "Ensure your desktop pet data is safely synced to your cloud account."}}
2: [home, new_flow] Desktop setup status preview new flow: Insert a desktop environment setup status checklist screen during the waiting sequence.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "new_setup_status", "home_intro"], "waiting": {"show_progress": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 15}, "new_setup_status": {"headline": "Preparing Desktop Environment", "body": "Verifying screen display permissions and pet animation renderer.", "layout": "checklist"}}

   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Select Your Ideal Desktop Companion", "body": "Compare companion behaviors and choose the pet that suits your desktop background."}}
4: [choose_path, copy] Clear path selection intent copy update: Update headline and body on the path choice screen to provide direct contrast between preset adoption and photo creation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "How Would You Like to Get Your Desktop Pet?", "body": "Adopt a ready-to-play companion or build a custom pet using your own photos."}}
5: [finish, layout] Home intro checklist layout finish step: Switch home intro layout to a checklist style highlighting setup completion milestones.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Your Desktop Companion is Ready to Launch", "body": "Review your pet setup summary and spawn your companion on screen."}}
6: [home, wait_info] Companion rendering tips waiting screen info: Display practical advice on waiting screen regarding desktop pet placement while rendering completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Tip: Once ready, your pet can freely wander your desktop or stay anchored to active windows."}}
7: [adoption, hint] Custom photo upload formatting hint: Add photo quality and framing guidance hints on the upload photos screen.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Upload clear, well-lit photos focused on your pet for optimal 3D generation accuracy."}}
8: [sign_in, notification] Account pet sync confirmation notification: Enable ready notification flag on sign-in screen to confirm account sync status.
   config: {"sign_in": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Your pet collection and setup progress will automatically back up to your account."}}
9: [choose_path, incentive] Story screen starter companion bonus incentive: Add an incentive badge on the story screen highlighting starter companion perks.
   config: {"story": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Includes Free Interactive Desktop Accessories", "style": "highlight"}]}}
